products.body:
[MEDICUBE PDRN Firming Gua Sha Care Set] Multi Balm + Neck Cream

Description

A targeted firming and moisture care duo featuring the MEDICUBE PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm and PDRN Collagen Gua Sha Neck Wrinkle Cream, specially curated to care for areas prone to dryness, loss of elasticity, and visible fine lines.

Together, the portable multi balm and built-in gua sha neck cream provide concentrated hydration and firming care for the face, jawline, neck, and décolleté, helping the skin appear smoother, more supple, and naturally radiant.

MEDICUBE PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm 10g

- A concentrated moisturizing balm formulated with PDRN, collagen, hyaluronic acid, and peptides to provide targeted elasticity and radiance care.

- Helps nourish dry or less elastic areas while creating a smooth, healthy-looking glow.

- Provides convenient moisture and firming care for areas such as the forehead, around the eyes, smile lines, cheeks, neck, and other areas prone to dryness.

- Features an easy-to-use stick format that glides smoothly over the skin without requiring direct hand contact.

- Can be used as the final step of a skincare routine or applied before and after makeup whenever the skin needs additional moisture and luminosity.

- Ideal for carrying throughout the day for quick, targeted firming and glow care.

MEDICUBE PDRN Collagen Gua Sha Neck Wrinkle Cream 50ml

- A targeted neck and décolleté cream featuring a built-in gua sha applicator for simultaneous skincare and massage care.

- Formulated with PDRN, hydrolyzed collagen, peptides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, adenosine, ceramide, and retinol to support hydration, elasticity, and wrinkle care.

- Helps moisturize dry neck skin and improve the appearance of fine lines and uneven skin texture.

- The rich, moisture-locking formula helps strengthen the skin’s protective moisture barrier while leaving the neck area feeling soft and supple.

- The integrated gua sha head allows the cream to be smoothly massaged along the jawline, neck, and décolleté without using the hands.

- Perfect for a daily firming massage routine targeting the neck and lower facial contours.

How to Use

Daily Firming Gua Sha Care

- At the final step of your skincare routine, gently apply the MEDICUBE PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm to areas requiring additional moisture, elasticity, or radiance.

- Glide the balm over areas such as the forehead, around the eyes, smile lines, cheeks, jawline, and neck. Gently pat with your fingertips if additional absorption is needed.

- Next, rotate the gua sha head of the MEDICUBE PDRN Collagen Gua Sha Neck Wrinkle Cream until the arrow is aligned with the ON position.

- Gently press the tube to dispense an appropriate amount of cream, then massage along the jawline, neck, and décolleté using upward and outward motions until absorbed.

Recommended Massage Routine

- Begin at the center of the chin and glide the gua sha head outward along the jawline.
- Move from the base of the neck upward toward the jawline using gentle strokes.
- Finish by massaging outward across the décolleté area toward the shoulders.
- Use light, comfortable pressure and avoid repeatedly rubbing sensitive areas.

Recommended Routine
- Use consistently as part of your daily morning and evening skincare routine.
- The multi balm may also be reapplied throughout the day or used before and after makeup whenever additional moisture or radiance is needed.
- For daytime use, finish your morning skincare routine with a broad-spectrum sunscreen.

Specs

Brand: MEDICUBE
Capacity: 10g Multi Balm + 50ml Neck Cream
Target Area: Face, Jawline, Neck & Décolleté
Skin Type: All Skin Types (Dry, Dull & Elasticity-Concerned Skin)
Country of Origin: South Korea
